purpose: V-008 ScopedPermissions configs (prototype verification/prototypes/v008-permissions). mut_* configs disable one rule and must violate; trap_* are golden witnesses.

models.claim: no self-escalation, no capability created outside a governance root, high-risk caps only via quorum, cascade revocation
no transitive/unilateral Space authority; mirror within binding ceiling; Space revocation eventually dominates (liveness)
quorum counted only from governance in force; concurrent sealed successors freeze
mutation: role manager grants outside its delegation ceiling
mutation: a restricted moderator lifts its own restriction
mutation: an approval from a since-removed governor still counts
mutation: Room accepts a Space role authored by that Space's own parent (S1->S2->Room)
design gap: without cascade, grants issued from revoked Space authority outlive the revocation
mutation: a Space that only lists the Room (one-sided link) gets authority
golden: two concurrently sealed successors of one head freeze privileged transitions
golden: add_bridge reaches a principal only after 2-of-2 approval
golden: Space-delegated moderation materialises through the Room's own binding
golden: revoking a Space role invalidates grants issued from it
golden: ownership transfer is add-successor then remove-predecessor under quorum
